## Player settings, and full rpemotes-reborn integration

> [!WARNING]
> **Breaking change. Read this before you update.**
>
> This version requires [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) **2.1.2 or newer** ([release notes](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn/releases/tag/v2.1.2)).
>
> mbt_emote_menu now depends entirely on rpemotes-reborn. It reads the emote catalog through rpemotes' `GetEmoteCatalog` export and plays every emote through `Execute`, both shipped in 2.1.2. We dropped our own copy of the loader, so there is **no fallback**: on an older rpemotes the menu stays disabled and prints a notice in the server console asking you to update.
>
> **Update rpemotes-reborn to 2.1.2+ first, then update this resource.**

### Why this change

rpemotes-reborn is the source of truth for emotes, walks, expressions, props and emojis. We used to parse its files ourselves, which drifted out of sync whenever a server changed its rpemotes setup and duplicated work rpemotes already does. Reading its official exports instead is simpler, stays correct, and means new rpemotes content shows up in the menu with no extra work. Nothing changes for your players. It is the same catalog, just sourced the right way.

### Added: settings popover

A per-player settings menu in the header ("..."). Each player picks their own and the menu remembers it:

- **Layout:** switch between the standard and cinematic designs (you can lock this with `MBT.Menu.AllowLayoutSwitch`)
- **Panel side:** left or right
- **Performance mode:** turns off the ambient effects, vignette, entrance animation and hover preview for steadier FPS on weaker PCs
- **Emote wheel:** radial or linear
- **Language:** each player can pick their own UI language
- **Close on play:** keep the menu open to chain emotes, or close it on play
- **Accent:** a small set of accent presets, off by default (opt in with `MBT.Theme.AllowAccentChange`)

### Changed

- **Emoji reactions now come from rpemotes-reborn.** The bundled custom emoji feature is gone. rpemotes' own emoji system is networked, distance-filtered, rate-limited and ships more glyphs. For players the "Emojis" category and playback are unchanged, just powered by rpemotes now.
- **18+ and abusable emotes are controlled by rpemotes' own config** (`AdultEmotesDisabled` / `AbusableEmotesDisabled`) instead of a duplicate flag in this menu.

### Removed

- The legacy server-side catalog loader (the AnimationList.lua sandbox parser) and the dual-path integration. One code path now, built from the export.

### Fixed

- The placement overlay closes on confirm with a smooth fade instead of lingering over the playing emote.
- The menu recovers on its own if rpemotes-reborn starts after it or is restarted live, instead of getting stuck with an empty catalog.

### Install

1. Update [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) to **2.1.2 or newer**.
2. Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and replace your resource folder.

If the menu does not open and the console shows a "requires rpemotes-reborn 2.1.2+" notice, rpemotes is still on an older version.
